title: Proper binary factor witness
statement: For a natural number $\ell$, let $m,a,b\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^\ell$. The Boolean test returns true exactly when both $a$ and $b$ differ from the all-one coefficient vector of length $\ell$, and their binary convolution coefficients agree with the monic coefficients specified by $m$ in every degree from $0$ through $2\ell$.
